source: GDACS — Global Disaster Alert and Coordination System
name: GDACS — Global Disaster Alert and Coordination System
geometryLevel: point, polygon and country (varies by event)
scheduleDescription: Checked approximately every 20 minutes (external timer plus a GitHub Actions schedule as backup). Actual run times may be delayed.
provides: Alerts for major earthquakes, tropical cyclones, floods, volcanoes, droughts and wildfires, with the GDACS alert level (Green / Orange / Red) and affected countries when supplied.
coverage: Global, but limited to events large enough to trigger GDACS automatic or manual assessment.
coverageLimitations: GDACS is an alert and coordination system. Its alert levels are model-based estimates of humanitarian impact and can change as assessments evolve. Many events are represented by a single representative coordinate; the affected area may be much broader.
licenseOrAttribution: Source: GDACS (European Commission Joint Research Centre and UN OCHA). See the GDACS terms of use; attribution required.
notes: Event list from SEARCH; 478 of 478 events have a published affected area.
